patients.summary: Healthy young delivery contractor who joined in 2022 and then had three trauma admissions: a 2025 bicycle crash with a right clavicle fracture, small pneumothorax and subclavian artery injury; a 2025 car crash with a left tension pneumothorax; and a 2026 crash with hemorrhagic shock, liver laceration and left femur fracture, managed without blood as a Jehovah's Witness.

documents.title: New Patient Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller would like to establish here; moved his care because his old office stopped taking his marketplace plan. Works for himself doing deliveries, mostly mornings and evenings, so midday works best. No current health complaints, just wants a regular doctor. Booked new patient physical 9/13 at 1:20. Membership info and intake forms sent to his email. Asked him to have his old office send records; release form attached to the email.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26M here to establish primary care. Previous PCP in the area, last seen there roughly two years ago for a sports-type physical. Feels well. No complaints today.

PMH: none. No hospitalizations. PSH: none.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: no known drug allergies.
FHx: father with hypertension, diagnosed in his early 50s. Mother has hypothyroidism. No bleeding or clotting problems in the family that he knows of, no connective tissue disease.
SHx: self-employed delivery work, app-based, split between his car and a bicycle depending on the route and season. Lives alone in an apartment. Never smoked, no vaping. Drinks maybe once or twice a month. No drug use. Wears a helmet on the bike, seatbelt always.
Faith: Jehovah's Witness. He volunteered that he does not accept blood transfusion and asked that we know that. Noted in chart.

ROS: negative across systems.

Exam: well-appearing, fit. HEENT normal, TMs clear. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no organomegaly. Skin without lesions of concern. Extremities with full range, pulses 2+ throughout. Neuro grossly intact.

PHQ-2: 0.

Assessment/plan:
1. Adult wellness, healthy 26 year old. Baseline CBC, CMP and lipids today. One-time HIV and hepatitis C screening, discussed and he agrees.
2. Tdap given; he cannot recall a tetanus booster since school.
3. Flu and COVID when the fall supply is in, nurse visit.
4. Road safety talk was short, he is already careful.
Records release signed for prior office. Recheck in about a year.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Brandon, everything from Tuesday came back fine. Blood counts, kidney and liver tests, sugar and cholesterol are all where they should be, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to do. Good to meet you.

documents.title: Records From Prior Primary Care Office
documents.author: outside primary care
documents.body:
Received by fax, 9 pages. Prior office visits 2016 through 2020: two preventive visits and a college sports clearance. Normal exams each time, blood pressure normal at every visit. No problems listed, no medications, no known drug allergies. Childhood immunization record attached: MMR x2, varicella x2, hepatitis B series, polio series complete. No tetanus booster in the records since adolescence. No labs beyond a normal CBC in 2018.

Reviewed by PCP; nothing new. Immunization history abstracted.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In for flu and bivalent COVID booster. Screening questions negative, feeling well, no prior vaccine reactions. Flu to left deltoid, COVID to right deltoid. VIS given. Observed 15 min, no reaction. Pt says he has a long delivery shift tonight and was told he may be sore.

documents.title: Form Question
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hey, one of the delivery apps wants a doctor to sign off that I'm fit to do bike deliveries for a new program they're running. Is that something you guys do or do I need to come in?

documents.title: RE: Form Question
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Happy to. You were just seen in September with a normal exam, so upload the form here and I'll fill it out without a visit.

documents.title: Form Completed
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Fitness form for delivery program completed and signed by PCP, scanned to chart, copy sent to pt through portal.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. Doing fine. Busy summer of bike deliveries, now shifting more to the car as it gets colder. No injuries this year. Sleeps okay.

No meds. NKDA. Still never smoker, alcohol rare.
Family history unchanged.

ROS negative.

Exam: NAD. Heart RRR no murmur. Lungs clear bilat. Abdomen benign. No edema. Skin fine.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P: healthy 27M.
- Labs normal last year; nothing due.
- Flu shot today. He'll get the updated COVID at his pharmacy when convenient.
- Reminded about helmet and reflective gear for evening routes.
See in a year.

documents.title: Pharmacy Immunization Record
documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: State immunization registry update from a community pharmacy: COVID-19 vaccine, 2023-2024 formula, given 11/04/2023, left deltoid. No reaction reported. Added to immunization history by MA.

documents.title: New Insurance Card
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Renewed my marketplace plan for this year, same company but new member ID. Uploaded the front and back of the card. Let me know if you need anything else.

documents.title: RE: New Insurance Card
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Got it, thanks Brandon. Your file is updated with the new ID.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Brandon is in for his yearly check. No concerns. Still doing app deliveries full time, roughly half on the bike in good weather. No falls or crashes. Energy good.

Medications: none. Allergies: NKDA.
Social: never smoker, a drink or two a month, no drugs.

Review of systems: negative.

Exam: BP and pulse normal today. Alert, comfortable. Ears and throat normal. No lymphadenopathy. Heart regular without murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Normal gait and strength, full range of shoulders and knees. Skin clear.

PHQ-2 negative.

Impression: well adult, 28.
Plan: flu vaccine given. Lipids not due until next year. Continue helmet use. Return next fall for physical.
